notes: 3 photos, all menu boards/cards, but each shows a different price revision of the same shop. Used photo 1 (chalkboard board) as the primary source since it lists the most items; photos 2 and 3 show overlapping items at different (older/newer) prices and were not merged in to avoid mixing price versions.
